items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: But Billy was nice. I liked him as a leader, you know.

ctx.x: the same deal, but I mean, I can't remember which band who was in... But Billy was nice. I liked him as a leader, you know. Billy had a lot of personality, and Billy could drink a lot of whiskey and never change anything. You'd never know he'd had a drink.
So Minnow was out and Coleman was in as far as you know?
